theme_and_archetype.rationale: Healthcare and life-safety require trust, calm, and clarity. A dark mode tech-bro aesthetic or generic SaaS purple feels unapproachable and panic-inducing. We are using Warm Bone-White and Deep Forest Green to evoke premium medical technology (akin to AliveCor) while maintaining the approachability required for visually impaired seniors.

typography.strategy: The 'Soft Utility' pair. Outfit brings geometric premium-tech feel to headings, while Manrope excels in dense data readability (vital for Staff Dashboard) and offers clear digit rendering.

scales.h1: text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-light tracking-tighter leading-none text-primary
scales.kiosk_main: text-4xl md:text-5xl lg:text-7xl font-medium tracking-tight leading-tight

kiosk.note: Ultra-accessible. 120px min touch targets. Avoid complex layouts. 2/3 of screen dedicated to AI Voice interaction visualizer, 1/3 dedicated to massive structural EMERGENCY trigger.

dashboard.style: Control Room Grid. High density. Every pixel utilized. Cardless design or 1px subtle borders (border-default) with NO soft shadows. Utilize optical alignment for data tables.

landing.grid: Tetris Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-12). Asymmetric flow.

surfaces_and_micro_themes.kiosk_cards: Flat solid surfaces (bg-surface) with 2px borders (border-primary/10) to create a skeuomorphic 'physical object' feel for seniors. NO glassmorphism here (too confusing).
surfaces_and_micro_themes.dashboard_widgets: Flat, sharp borders, bg-surface. Data tables must use alternating subtle row colors (bg-background/50) instead of heavy grid lines.
surfaces_and_micro_themes.emergency_button: Tactile Neumorphism. Deep terracotta (alerts.emergency) with a solid 4px bottom border (alerts.emergency_hover) to look physically pressable. No glowing neon.
surfaces_and_micro_themes.navigation: Solid background (bg-background) with a hard bottom border for admin/staff. Sticky positioning.

motion_and_interactions.kiosk_voice_ai: Slow, organic pulse animation (Framer Motion) on a central SVG orb using colors: #153428 and #EAE7DF. Must feel like a calm breathing rhythm (3-4 second loops) to reassure residents.
motion_and_interactions.staff_alerts: Urgent but non-panicky pulse. Incoming alerts should fade in (opacity 0 to 1, y: 10 to 0) and feature a solid color left-border (4px) indicating severity.
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: All dashboard buttons/rows must instantly change bg-color on hover (e.g., hover:bg-background) for snappy, decisive feedback. High contrast.

components_strategy.buttons: Shadcn UI Buttons heavily customized. Kiosk buttons get custom 'h-[120px] text-3xl' classes. Dashboard buttons stay 'h-10 text-sm'.
components_strategy.forms: Shadcn Inputs and Selects. Labels must be bold and left-aligned. Inputs must have 1px solid border with focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary.
components_strategy.tables: Shadcn Table for Admin and Staff history. Must have data-testid on every interactive row.
components_strategy.icons: lucide-react. Use large, filled variants for the Kiosk (stroke-width: 2.5). Use standard (stroke-width: 2) for Dashboard.

image_urls.description: Nurse smiling with elderly patient. Use this as the primary emotive hero image on the landing page, overlay with bg-primary/20 for text contrast.
Caregiver assisting elderly women with tea. Use in the 'Comfort' feature block on the landing page.
ECG graph on grid background. Use as the 50% split-screen background for the Staff/Admin Login page, with a dark green (bg-primary/80) overlay.

logos.strategy: Typography-based logo: CAOSCare. Do not use random placeholder logo images.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: All text must pass WCAG AAA (7:1) for the Kiosk interface, and AA (4.5:1) for the Dashboard.
accessibility_and_testing.test_ids: Crucial requirement: Every button, input, alert card, and navigation link MUST have a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='kiosk-emergency-btn').
accessibility_and_testing.screen_readers: Include aria-labels for the AI voice visualizer and alert severity icons.
